column1: Built from the PPL + Upper/Lower (5-Day) program that ships in Badger 1.1.15. The sets, reps and rules are the app's, and weights are worked out the way the app works them out.
Run this program in Badger: https://badger.fit/programs/

Push / Pull / Legs on the first three days, then an upper and a lower day. Five sessions, two rest days you place where they suit you. Rep ranges: stay at the bottom of the range until you can hit the top on every set, then add weight.
Write the weight you used for each exercise in the week columns. Use the same unit all the way down.
